missing_material_qualifiers: "TabMix improves over no augmentation by 0.1 and 0.4 percentage points" on Adult and Credit-default is presented as an improvement without noting that these differences fall within the standard deviations (0.2–0.5).

X.trap_note: X reports every number accurately, including the Covertype drop, but never says the benefit is limited to the small dataset; it calls the within-noise Adult/Credit differences improvements, though it makes no explicit general-improvement claim.
